historical_investigation_answers.q1_task_relative_normalization_methods_t: Phase 7F tested causal task-relative normalization with K_min=2 minimum history fallback. Phase 7G tested hierarchical task/parent-job normalization. Phase 7H tested variance-floored and robust MAD-scaled hierarchical normalization.
historical_investigation_answers.q2_methods_with_near_zero_variance_blowu: Phase 7G Parent-Job Relative and Hierarchical Relative produced extreme feature blowups with maximum values reaching +2,751.48 and +12,905.59 due to near-zero variance in short historical intervals. Specifically cpu_utilization reached +2,222 and memory_utilization reached +8,768.
historical_investigation_answers.q3_scheduler_metadata_and_lifecycle_feat: Phase 7K evaluated M1 (peak and headroom, 36 feats), M2 (scheduler metadata: priority, class, requests, 35 feats), M3 (lifecycle and reschedule/eviction events, 33 feats), and M4 (combined eligible, 42 feats).
historical_investigation_answers.q4_did_7k_features_improve_ranking_or_ga: No. In Phase 7K, all feature variants (M1-M4) failed all operational gates across all three seeds under fixed policies. None resolved the sensitivity-specificity tradeoff.
historical_investigation_answers.q5_does_negative_platt_slope_occur_in_ev: No. In Phase 7P, negative Platt slopes occurred in Folds 0, 1, and 2 (a = -0.72, -0.29, -0.09). In contrast, Folds 3 and 4 exhibited positive slopes (a = +0.30, +0.59) and positive AUCs (0.65-0.70). The negative pooled slope was driven by the first three folds representing 72.3% of train windows.
historical_investigation_answers.q6_fold_0_influence_on_pooled_metrics: Fold 0 contains 643 windows from a single parent job (Job 3998246322) with only 6 failures (prevalence 0.93%) and an inverted raw AUC of 0.2611. Excluding Fold 0 shifts the intercept from -1.95 to -1.70, but the pooled slope remains slightly negative (a = -0.12 to -0.18) due to Folds 1 and 2.
historical_investigation_answers.q7_does_7p_calibrator_outperform_prevale: No. The Phase 7P calibrated Brier score (0.125955) is virtually identical to a constant-prevalence predictor (p = 0.1467, Brier = 0.125844). Calibration contracted all probabilities to the base rate without providing failure discrimination, and its negative slope inverted the raw ranking.
historical_investigation_answers.q8_are_n2_checkpoints_reproducible: Yes. Inference on saved Phase 7N checkpoints reproduces validation predictions with maximum absolute error < 3.0e-8 across all three seeds.
